other.name: National Veterans Day Observance at Arlington National Cemetery
other.where: Memorial Amphitheater, Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, VA (about 20 miles east via I-66 or Silver Line)
other.offer: National Veterans Day Observance: a wreath-laying at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at 11:00, then the observance in the Memorial Amphitheater. Free and open to the public.
other.note: Expect security screening at the Welcome Center; allow extra time.

other.name: George Washington's Mount Vernon: free admission for military
other.where: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Hwy, Mount Vernon, VA (about 28 miles southeast)
other.offer: Free admission for all active-duty, former and retired military personnel (not family or guests); free tickets on arrival. Veterans may place a floral tribute at the New Tomb and get a quarter-slice of 18th-century bread at the Half Crown Bakehouse while it lasts. Harmony Heritage Singers 11:00, U.S. Army Woodwind Quintet 12:30, Sons and Daughters of the American Revolution ceremony at the New Tomb 1:00, U.S. Air Force Strings 2:00.
other.note: Its page doesn't say what proof to bring: carry a military ID, VA card or DD-214.

other.name: DC Prime Steaks: free 9-oz Top Sirloin for veterans

other.offer: A free 9-oz Top Sirloin for veterans dining in on Wednesday, 11 Nov (veterans only: the restaurant's post doesn't name active duty).
other.note: Dine-in only; bring ID showing veteran status; tax and tip not included. Opens at 4 PM. It expects to be fully booked: reserve, (703) 840-2099. Outside the route circles (Broadlands, Ashburn).

other.name: Great Falls Park & National Park Service sites: fee-free day
other.where: 9200 Old Dominion Dr, McLean, VA 22102 (15 minutes northeast of Reston) and all NPS sites
other.offer: Entrance fees waived on Wednesday, 11 Nov at Great Falls Park, Shenandoah National Park, Manassas National Battlefield and all National Park Service sites for US citizens and residents.
other.note: Veterans and Gold Star families also qualify for a free lifetime Interagency Military Pass at any federal recreation site.

other.name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center
other.where: 14390 Air and Space Museum Pkwy, Chantilly, VA 20151 (10 minutes south of Reston/Herndon via Route 28)
other.offer: Free admission every day. On 11 Nov, veterans and active-duty military get free parking (usually $15 before 4 PM) and $2 off each daytime IMAX ticket with a valid military ID; free docent tours from 10:30 AM, and the museum's Shake Shack takes 20% off shakes for current and former military.
other.note: Outside the route circles (Chantilly, off Route 28).

other.name: Metro: half fare for veterans rated 60% or more

other.offer: Veterans with a VA disability rating of 60% or more qualify for Metro's Reduced Fare SmarTrip Photo ID card: half fare on Metrorail and Metrobus.

other.note: From FFXnow; the Park Authority's own 2026 notice wasn't found, so call the center or park first. Rec centers keep regular hours on the holiday (Park Authority holiday-hours page).
